fileKdoc: [Heroicons](https://heroicons.com) vector paths, generated from the SVGs vendored beside this
file under `src/commonMain/svg/`. Curves are real cubic Beziers and holes are
`UiFillRule.EvenOdd` contours; nothing here is hand-transcribed. Do not edit this file -- it is
overwritten by `./gradlew :awake:heroicons:generateImageVectors`. To add a glyph, vendor its
Nested one object per real Heroicons style+size tier, not a flat glyph list -- Heroicons ships
genuinely different path data per tier, so there is no single correct [ImageVector] per glyph
name. Match the tier to the icons already around it: a glyph borrowed from another tier renders
heavier or lighter than its neighbours in the same control.
A generic, unbranded home for icon vector data. Design-system recipes select source-specific
glyphs through their own registry rather than calling this data object directly.

tiers.label: 20/solid "mini"
kdoc: Heroicons' `20/solid` tier ("mini") -- the size real shadcn/ui's own chrome
(dropdown/collapsible chevrons, small inline affordances) actually uses.

tiers.label: 24/solid
kdoc: Heroicons' `24/solid` tier -- heavier and more detailed than the mini tier. Holds the
stack-shaped glyphs that only exist at 24, and nothing else; reach for [Solid20Mini] first.

tiers.label: 24/outline
